entries.name: Read an Opponent
entries.prerequisites: GM may require Wits 2 and 2 in relevant combat Ability
entries.summary: Spend an action assessing one opponent. Each success adds one die to your next action.
entries.special: Can be attempted at most Wits times per combat scene. At ranges beyond about 20 feet, a perceptual Mind or Correspondence Effect is also needed. PDF starts mid-entry; verify with the previous page if precision is required.
entries.sourceNote: The supplied excerpt starts in the middle of this maneuver.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 422
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 422

entries.name: Sweep
entries.roll: Dexterity + Brawl or Melee (Martial Arts/Do with Weapon Forms specialty)
entries.prerequisites: Weapon or leg sweep
entries.summary: Knock the opponent off their feet without inflicting damage.
entries.special: Target is prone/at disadvantage; a weapon sweep can use Martial Arts or Do with the stated specialty.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 422
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 422

entries.name: Tackle
entries.prerequisites: At least 2 yards of run-up
entries.summary: Launch into the target using speed and body weight.
entries.special: Both combatants then roll Dexterity + Athletics: attacker difficulty 6; target difficulty 6 plus attacker successes, or fall prone. Botches can injure the tackler. Extreme mass/force can make damage lethal.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 422
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 422

entries.name: Blinding
entries.prerequisites: Brawl 3 and suitable dirty-fighting experience/background
entries.summary: Target the eyes with dirt, gouging, or a similar improvised strike.
entries.special: Successes determine turns blinded; blinded target loses two dice. Severe injuries require Storyteller judgment.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423

entries.name: Body Slam
entries.prerequisites: Brawl 3 and suitable dirty-fighting experience/background; successful grapple first
entries.summary: Grapple, then slam the captive into the environment.
entries.special: Requires target to remain grappled until the following action. Hazardous surfaces can change damage to lethal.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423

entries.name: Curbstomp
entries.prerequisites: Brawl 3 and suitable dirty-fighting experience/background; target stunned or immobilized
entries.summary: Prepare a stunned or helpless target against a hard surface and strike.
entries.special: One action positions the target; the attack follows. Severe lasting injuries are Storyteller adjudication.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423

entries.name: Haymaker
entries.prerequisites: Brawl 3 and suitable dirty-fighting experience/background
entries.summary: Deliver a committed, forceful punch.
entries.special: Target can resist knockback with a Strength roll at difficulty 8; botched resistance can cause a fall.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423

entries.name: Head Butt
entries.prerequisites: Brawl 3 and suitable dirty-fighting experience/background
entries.summary: Strike with the forehead in close quarters.
entries.special: If target soaks all damage, attacker is stunned for a turn; striking a rigid foe may damage/stun the attacker.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423

entries.name: Jab Pistol
entries.prerequisites: Brawl 3 and suitable dirty-fighting experience/background; pistol in contact range
entries.summary: Press a pistol into the opponent and fire at contact distance.
entries.special: Uses Brawl rather than Firearms. Apply the carried pistol’s damage with +2 dice; not an ordinary unarmed damage roll.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423

entries.name: Low Blow
entries.prerequisites: Brawl 3 and suitable dirty-fighting experience/background
entries.summary: Strike an acutely vulnerable target.
entries.special: After soak, stun one turn per health level inflicted unless target makes Stamina difficulty 8; cutting or empowered variants may be lethal.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423

entries.name: Pistol Whip
entries.prerequisites: Brawl 3 and suitable dirty-fighting experience/background; gun or compact hard implement
entries.summary: Bludgeon the opponent with a compact rigid object.
entries.special: Target makes Stamina difficulty 8 or is stunned for one turn; a botch means two turns.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 423

entries.name: Counter Throw
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 1; Athletics 1; soft style
entries.summary: Use the attacker’s momentum to redirect an incoming hand-to-hand attack.
entries.special: Compare successes against the attacker’s Dexterity + combat Ability. More successes permits an immediate Throw without dividing the dice pool. On failure the defender still sidesteps.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 424
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 424

entries.name: Death Strike
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 3; hard style
entries.summary: Precisely strike a vulnerable joint or organ for lethal injury.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 424
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 424

entries.name: Deflecting Block
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 2; Athletics or Acrobatics 2; soft style
entries.summary: Redirect an incoming attack instead of absorbing it.
entries.special: Each defender success negates an attacker success. If defender exceeds attacker, attacker tests Dexterity difficulty 8 or falls and suffers its own Strength in bashing damage.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425

entries.name: Dragon Tail Sweep
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 1; Athletics or Acrobatics 1; hard style
entries.summary: A spinning leg sweep that drops a target without first grappling.
entries.special: The printed move states it uses throw-like effects, but lists the opponent’s Strength as damage.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425

entries.name: Elbow / Knee Strike
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 1; any style
entries.summary: Short-range elbow or knee attack.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425

entries.name: Flying Kick
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 1; Athletics or Acrobatics 1; hard style
entries.summary: Leaping kick combining momentum and weight.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425

entries.name: Hard Strike
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 1; any style
entries.summary: Direct, focused blow using hard-style principles.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425

entries.name: Soft Strike
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 1; any style
entries.summary: Use timing and an opponent’s movement to land a redirecting strike.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425

entries.name: Joint Lock
entries.damage: One lethal health level per success
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 2; Athletics or Acrobatics 2; any style; grapple
entries.summary: Pressure a secured joint to incapacitate or injure.
entries.special: First grapple, then the martial artist may immediately roll to inflict damage without splitting the dice pool. Damage uses successes as health levels, not a Strength damage pool.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425

entries.name: Nerve / Pressure Point Strike
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 3; any style
entries.summary: Hit a pressure point to damage and potentially stun.
entries.special: On at least 3 hit successes, victim makes Stamina difficulty 8 or is stunned next turn; botching that resistance means 3 turns stunned.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425

entries.name: Snake Step (Hard)
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 1; Athletics or Acrobatics 1; any style
entries.summary: Evade a visible close or ranged attack with hard-style footwork.
entries.special: Dodge roll receives three bonus dice; defender must be aware of the attack.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425

entries.name: Snake Step (Soft)
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 1; Athletics or Acrobatics 1; any style
entries.summary: Evade a visible close or ranged attack with flowing footwork.
entries.special: Dodge roll receives three bonus dice; defender must be aware of the attack.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 425

entries.name: Snap Kick
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 1; hard style
entries.summary: Fast kick with an economical, focused motion.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426

entries.name: Spinning Kick
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 2; Athletics or Acrobatics 2; hard style
entries.summary: Rotating kick that leverages the whole body.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426

entries.name: Throw (Hard)
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 2; grapple/counter throw or other opening
entries.summary: Throw a secured foe against the ground or a chosen surface.
entries.special: Requires attacker’s Dexterity + Martial Arts pool >= target Dexterity. Throw distance is up to successes in yards; excess momentum adds impact dice. Stun and multi-target throws have extra conditions.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426

entries.name: Throw (Soft)
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 2; grapple/counter throw or other opening
entries.summary: Use leverage and momentum to throw the target.
entries.special: Requires attacker’s Dexterity + Martial Arts pool >= target Dexterity. Throw distance is up to successes in yards; moving targets and thrown bodies may cause additional damage.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426

entries.name: Thunder Kick
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 3; Athletics or Acrobatics 2; hard style
entries.summary: A high-commitment aerial strike, adding attack successes as extra damage dice.
entries.special: Can be performed no more than once every five turns. Extra damage dice are not automatically computed by this item.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426

entries.name: Vital Strike
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 2; hard style
entries.summary: A sharp, precise blow that produces lethal injury.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426

entries.name: Withering Grasp
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts 3; soft style
entries.summary: Painful control hold with an opportunity to disarm.
entries.special: At least 3 successes can disarm; 5 successes permits seizing the weapon and using it on a later turn.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426

entries.name: Arrow Cutting
entries.prerequisites: Do 2+ and one selected special technique slot; Akashic teaching/training restrictions apply
entries.summary: Intercept an incoming arrow-speed projectile.
entries.special: Deflect slow missiles at difficulty 7; catching and returning one on a later action needs difficulty 9. Does not normally work on bullets.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 428
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 428

entries.name: Hurricane Throw
entries.prerequisites: Do 2+ and one selected special technique slot; Akashic teaching/training restrictions apply
entries.summary: Hurl a grabbed opponent with exceptional force.
entries.special: Every attack success adds a die to the listed base damage pool. Despite Do unarmed techniques being often lethal, this one is bashing.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429

entries.name: Iron Shirt
entries.roll: Adds Do rating to soak roll
entries.prerequisites: Do 2+ and one selected special technique slot; Akashic teaching/training restrictions apply
entries.summary: A trained defensive state adds the character’s Do rating as bonus soak dice.
entries.special: Normally does not allow soaking lethal damage. A blow exceeding Stamina still causes at least one level of damage despite this technique. Passive technique; no attack roll.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429

entries.name: Kiaijutsu — Stamina
entries.damage: Stamina bonus: one dot per success for 3 turns
entries.prerequisites: Do 2+ and one selected special technique slot; Akashic teaching/training restrictions apply; once per combat
entries.summary: A forceful kiai temporarily bolsters physical resilience.
entries.special: This is one of three possible Iron Shout applications; the technique may be used only once per combat overall.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429

entries.name: Kiaijutsu — Terror
entries.prerequisites: Do 2+ and one selected special technique slot; Akashic teaching/training restrictions apply; once per combat
entries.summary: Project a kiai intended to frighten or immobilize opponents.
entries.special: Each success adds +1 difficulty to the target’s next action (cap +3). Further fear/stun consequences depend on successes vs target Willpower; mass effect only against weak-willed foes.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429

entries.name: Kiaijutsu — Eloquence
entries.damage: Bonus successes on next social/performance roll
entries.prerequisites: Do 2+ and one selected special technique slot; Akashic teaching/training restrictions apply; once per combat
entries.summary: Channel the shout into persuasive or intimidating speech.
entries.special: Each success adds one success to the next suitable Expression, Leadership, Intimidation, or performance-related Art roll.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429

entries.name: Plum Flower Blossom
entries.damage: None; +2 attack damage dice if used for a leap attack
entries.prerequisites: Do 2+ and one selected special technique slot; Akashic teaching/training restrictions apply
entries.summary: Double a jump or move nimbly across obstacles for a brief period.
entries.special: Duration is one turn plus one per two successes. Turning a leap into an attack increases difficulty by 1, adds 2 damage dice, and still requires separate actions/split pools.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429

entries.name: Soft Fist
entries.damage: Attacker Strength + weapon + excess defensive successes
entries.prerequisites: Do 2+ and one selected special technique slot; Akashic teaching/training restrictions apply
entries.summary: Catch a melee blow and redirect it to a nearby target.
entries.special: If defense exceeds the incoming attack, redirected damage gains dice equal to the defender’s surplus successes.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429

entries.name: Ten Thousand Weapons
entries.damage: Improvised: Do dice bashing; ordinary bashing becomes lethal; lethal +1 die
entries.prerequisites: Do 2+ and one selected special technique slot; Akashic teaching/training restrictions apply
entries.summary: Turn ordinary objects into surprisingly effective weapons.
entries.special: Choose attack and damage based on the object. For nonweapons, damage is one die per Do dot. This is not a flat Strength-based strike.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429

entries.name: Typhoon Kick
entries.damage: Strength +5 + hit successes, bashing or lethal
entries.prerequisites: Do 2+ and one selected special technique slot; Akashic teaching/training restrictions apply
entries.summary: Major Do kick with devastating momentum.
entries.special: At most once per five turns. The wielder chooses bashing or lethal. If the target is rigid or soaks everything, the attacker must soak or suffer half the outgoing damage, rounded down.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 430
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 430

entries.name: Weapon Art
entries.damage: As weapon (may upgrade bashing to lethal)
entries.prerequisites: Do 2+ and one selected special technique slot; Akashic teaching/training restrictions apply; familiar Melee weapon for each Melee dot
entries.summary: Apply Do mastery with specifically trained hand weapons.
entries.special: Requires Dexterity + Do pool at least as high as Dexterity + Melee. Applies to familiar melee weapons, certain bows and thrown weapons; never firearms. Can apply Arrow Cutting, but not to projectiles with a weapon.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 430
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 430

entries.name: Thunder Punch (Magick Trick)
entries.roll: Attack roll after optional Sphere Effect
entries.prerequisites: Sphere ratings/focus sufficient for the attempted augmentation
entries.summary: Use an appropriate Sphere Effect to justify an extraordinary hand-to-hand strike.
entries.special: Typical combinations can involve Correspondence, Forces, Life, Mind, Prime, Matter, or Time. The actual Effect, Paradox, and damage are adjudicated separately; this is not a free rote.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 422
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 422

entries.name: Drunken Style (Optional)
entries.roll: Uses normal Martial Arts or Do rolls
entries.prerequisites: Storyteller enables optional style; Drunken Style or Broken Rhythm specialty
entries.summary: Unpredictable movements make deliberate attacks harder to anticipate.
entries.special: Optional sidebar rule offers a defense difficulty adjustment against attacks from adversaries who lack the style; does not replace standard maneuvers.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 424
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 424

entries.name: Kuei Lung Chuan — Dragon Spirit Kung Fu
entries.prerequisites: Appropriate Tiger School training
entries.summary: An example fighting style emphasizing a subset of advanced strikes and defensive techniques.
entries.special: Campaign example, not an additional universal move. Identifies preferred moves including Death Strike, Dragon Tail Sweep, Hard Strike, Snake Step, Thunder Kick, and Withering Grasp.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 427
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 427

entries.name: The Peaceful Way (Optional)
entries.damage: Bonus success on noncombat limb-related task
entries.prerequisites: Do training; Storyteller enables this optional rule
entries.summary: Apply Do principles to peaceful, focused actions associated with the Eight Limbs.
entries.special: Optional subsystem; each success on the preceding Willpower/Do check can add successes to a suitable task. Combat applications are excluded.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 428
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 428

entries.name: Catching Bullets (Magick Trick)
entries.prerequisites: Time 3 and/or Forces 2 with Life 2 suggested; Storyteller approval
entries.summary: Augment extreme reflexes to catch or redirect bullets.
entries.special: A magick trick, not an innate Do technique. The sidebar emphasizes Sphere requirements and Paradox; it does not permit ordinary Arrow Cutting to stop bullets.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 429

entries.name: Martial Arts — Learning Maneuvers
entries.prerequisites: Martial Arts training
entries.summary: Two learned maneuvers per dot in Martial Arts; each maneuver also has minimum ratings and sometimes a hard/soft style requirement.
entries.special: Learning a maneuver is separate from buying a dot. A martial art used as magickal focus generally needs Martial Arts or Do skill sufficient for the Sphere level.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 424
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 424

entries.name: Do — Training and Mastery
entries.prerequisites: Akashic or trusted disciple; ongoing training
entries.summary: Starting characters cannot begin with more than Do 2. The Way requires continuous practice and broad training beyond fighting.
entries.special: Do substitutes for certain combat maneuvers, often improves mundane combat precision, can inflict lethal unarmed damage, and provides special defenses. Two martial maneuvers per Do dot plus one special Do technique for each dot above the first. It does not permit dirty fighting.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 426

entries.name: Do — Eight Limbs of Expertise
entries.prerequisites: Two dots in a noncombat limb-related Ability per Do dot
entries.summary: Training includes unarmed art, meditation, bodily wellness, daily work, ethics, weapon craft, humility, and conflict balancing.
entries.special: The sidebar names Dharmamukti, Dhyana, Jivahasta, Karma, Prajna, Shastamarga, Sunyatade, and Tricanmarga, each associated with Abilities. Review the source for the complete disciplines.
entries.source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 428
entries.notes: Source: Mage: The Ascension 20th Anniversary Edition, p. 428
